SELECT r.id,r.owner_id,u.nickname,u.short_id,u.mobile,r.book_id,b.book_name,b.book_type,b.level_code,r.round_no,r.selected_at,r.ended_at,r.carried_learned_count,r.final_learned_count,r.first_studied_at,r.last_studied_at,r.study_count,r.reviewed_count,r.study_day_count,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vocabulary_book_word w WHERE w.book_id=r.book_id) total_words,CASE WHEN r.ended_at IS NULL THEN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT lr.content_id) FROM learning_record lr JOIN vocabulary_book_word w ON w.content_id=lr.content_id WHERE lr.owner_id=r.owner_id AND w.book_id=r.book_id AND lr.learning_status IN ('understood','mastered')) ELSE COALESCE(r.final_learned_count,(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT lr.content_id) FROM learning_record lr JOIN vocabulary_book_word w ON w.content_id=lr.content_id WHERE lr.owner_id=r.owner_id AND w.book_id=r.book_id AND lr.learning_status IN ('understood','mastered'))) END learned_words,CASE WHEN r.ended_at IS NULL THEN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT lr.content_id) FROM learning_record lr JOIN vocabulary_book_word w ON w.content_id=lr.content_id WHERE lr.owner_id=r.owner_id AND w.book_id=r.book_id AND lr.learning_status='mastered') ELSE 0 END mastered_words,CASE WHEN r.ended_at IS NULL THEN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT lr.content_id) FROM learning_record lr JOIN vocabulary_book_word w ON w.content_id=lr.content_id WHERE lr.owner_id=r.owner_id AND w.book_id=r.book_id AND lr.learning_status='learning') ELSE 0 END learning_words,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vocabulary_book_reset_log l WHERE l.round_id=r.id) reset_times,(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(l.reset_count),0) FROM vocabulary_book_reset_log l WHERE l.round_id=r.id) reset_word_total,(SELECT MAX(l.reset_at) FROM vocabulary_book_reset_log l WHERE l.round_id=r.id) last_reset_at,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_vocabulary_book ub WHERE ub.owner_id=r.owner_id AND ub.book_id=r.book_id AND ub.state='active') current_book FROM vocabulary_book_study_record r JOIN app_user u ON u.id=r.owner_id JOIN vocabulary_book b ON b.id=r.book_id WHERE r.id=#{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM learning_record lr JOIN vocabulary_book_word w ON w.content_id=lr.content_id

SELECT lr.content_id,lr.learning_status,lr.familiarity_percent,lr.first_completed_at,lr.last_feedback_at,COALESCE(cv.word_term,cv.title) word,cv.meaning,cv.phonetic,cv.difficulty,CASE WHEN wn.id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END in_notebook FROM learning_record lr JOIN vocabulary_book_word w ON w.content_id=lr.content_id JOIN learning_content c ON c.id=lr.content_id LEFT JOIN content_version cv ON cv.id=COALESCE(lr.last_version_id,c.published_version_id) LEFT JOIN word_notebook wn ON wn.owner_id=lr.owner_id AND wn.content_id=lr.content_id AND wn.state='active' ORDER BY lr.first_completed_at DESC,lr.content_id LIMIT #{offset},#{limit}
SELECT id,book_name,level_code FROM vocabulary_book WHERE state='active' ORDER BY sort_no,book_name

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM learning_record lr JOIN vocabulary_book_word w ON w.content_id=lr.content_id WHERE lr.owner_id=#{filter.ownerId} AND w.book_id=#{filter.bookId} AND lr.learning_status IN ('understood','mastered')
SELECT reset_at,reset_count,paused_review_count FROM vocabulary_book_reset_log WHERE round_id=#{id} ORDER BY reset_at DESC

SELECT DATE(COALESCE(lr.first_completed_at,lr.created_at)) business_day,COUNT(DISTINCT lr.content_id) new_words FROM learning_record lr JOIN vocabulary_book_word w ON w.content_id=lr.content_id WHERE lr.owner_id=#{filter.ownerId} AND w.book_id=#{filter.bookId} AND lr.learning_status IN ('understood','mastered') GROUP BY DATE(COALESCE(lr.first_completed_at,lr.created_at))
SELECT business_date,study_count,reviewed_count FROM vocabulary_book_study_daily WHERE round_id=#{id}
